c: Bring water, sugar and glucose to the boil; cool to below 10 °C.
Blend the syrup with the fruit purée and lemon juice; check Brix 28–30 %.
Churn to −6 °C; harden at −18 °C min 4 h. Serve at −12/−14 °C.
Warm milk and cream to 40 °C; whisk in milk powder, sugar and glucose.
Whisk in the yolks; heat to 85 °C (pasteurise), stirring.
Blend in the pistachio paste and salt; cool below 4 °C within 90 min.
Mature at 0–4 °C 12 h; blend again; churn to −6 °C.
Harden at −25 °C 2 h; serve at −12 to −14 °C with chopped pistachios.
cf6bb8ce.st: −18 °C, 2 weeks, covered. Never refreeze melted ice cream.
cf6bb8ce.al: 3 Eggs (egg yolks) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, cream 33%, skimmed milk powder) · 8 Nuts (pistachio paste 100%). Use pure pistachio paste (no colour, no almond).

c: Heat milk, cream and milk powder to 50 °C; whisk in half the sugar.
Whisk yolks with the rest of the sugar; temper and cook to 82–84 °C, stirring. Do not boil.
Strain, add vanilla; cool over ice to below 4 °C within 90 min.
Churn to −6/−8 °C; harden at −18 °C min 4 h. Serve at −12/−14 °C.
be2c0579.al: 3 Eggs (egg yolks) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, cream 33%, skimmed milk powder)

6830f224.yl: Yield: 1 GN 1/2 · 12 portions · Portion: ≈ 195 g (150 g crumble + 45 g sauce)
c: Cut apples in 2 cm dice; toss with lemon juice.
Melt butter, add apples, sugar and cinnamon; sauté 5–6 min (apples still holding shape).
Bind with starch slaked in a little water; boil 1 min; spread in a buttered GN.
Rub cold diced butter into flour, sugar, oats and salt to coarse crumbs; chill 15 min.
Scatter evenly over the apples (do not press).
Bake 175 °C convection 30–35 min (golden, juices bubbling at the edges).
Bring milk, cream and vanilla to the boil; pour onto yolks whisked with sugar.
Cook stirring to 82–84 °C (coats the spoon); strain; serve warm in a sauce jug.
Hot-hold crumble in the chafing dish ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h; refill with a fresh GN.
6830f224.st: Crumble baked: 0–4 °C, 48 h; reheat 160 °C 15 min (core ≥ 75 °C). Anglaise: 0–4 °C, 48 h.
6830f224.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, rolled oats) · 3 Eggs (egg yolks) · 7 Milk (butter, milk 3%, cream 33%)

725e1277.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 190 g (130 g bananas & sauce + 60 g ice cream)
c: Cut bananas in half lengthwise, then across (just before service, they darken).
Per order (2–3 portions): melt butter until nutty; add sugar and cinnamon; cook to a light caramel.
Add orange juice; add bananas cut side down; cook 1 min per side.
Add warm rum off the flame; ignite away from the hood; baste until the flame dies.
Plate over ice cream; spoon the sauce over.
Scoop the ice cream in advance onto a frozen tray; keep at −18 °C.
725e1277.st: Cook to order; caramel base (butter-sugar-juice): 0–4 °C, 3 days.
725e1277.al: 3 Eggs (vanilla ice cream) · 7 Milk (butter, vanilla ice cream). Contains alcohol (largely burnt off when flambéed).

c2a3c7c0.yl: Yield: 1 tray 30 × 40 cm · 16 portions · Portion: ≈ 120 g
c: Bring milk, sugar and zest to the boil; rain in semolina whisking; cook 4–5 min to a thick cream.
Off the heat beat in butter, then eggs one by one, and vanilla; cover with film; cool to 40 °C.
Lay 7–8 filo sheets in the buttered tray, brushing each with butter, overhanging the sides.
Spread the cream; fold the overhang over; cover with 6–7 buttered sheets; tuck in the edges.
Score the top into 16 portions (top layers only); sprinkle with water.
Bake 180 °C convection 35–40 min (deep golden, crisp); rest 15 min; cut through.
Dust with icing sugar and cinnamon at service; under the heat lamp max 40 min.
c2a3c7c0.al: 1 Gluten (semolina, filo pastry) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter)

c: Slice the brioche 1.5 cm; butter one side; cut into triangles.
Layer, buttered side up, in a buttered GN, scattering raisins between layers.
Warm milk and cream to 60 °C; whisk into eggs, yolks, sugar, vanilla and cinnamon; strain.
Pour over the bread; press down; soak 30 min.
Sprinkle brown sugar; bake in a bain-marie 160 °C convection 40–45 min (core 75 °C, just set).
Brush with warm apricot jam; serve warm with crème anglaise; hot-hold ≥ 63 °C.
67face91.al: 1 Gluten (brioche) · 3 Eggs (brioche, eggs, egg yolks) · 7 Milk (brioche, butter, milk 3%, cream 33%). Raisins: check label for sulphites.

1d8d857b.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 165 g (105 g cherries + 60 g ice cream)
c: Mise en place: caramelise sugar to light amber; add butter, orange and lemon juice; add cherries; simmer 4 min; bind lightly with starch; hold warm.
Per order (2–3 portions): heat the cherries in the flambé pan until bubbling.
Add warm kirsch off the flame; ignite away from the hood; shake until the flame dies.
Spoon over ice cream in a coupe; serve at once.
Scoop the ice cream in advance onto a frozen tray; keep at −18 °C until service.
1d8d857b.al: 3 Eggs (vanilla ice cream) · 7 Milk (butter, vanilla ice cream). Contains alcohol (largely burnt off when flambéed).

c: Brush 10 fondant moulds (150 ml) with butter in upward strokes and dust with cocoa; chill.
Melt chocolate and butter over a bain-marie to 45 °C.
Whisk eggs, yolks and sugar until light and pale.
Fold in the chocolate, then the sifted flour.
Fill the moulds three quarters full (90 g).
Bake at 200 °C convection 8–10 min until the outside is set and the centre still liquid.
1b695f7f.st: Raw filled moulds: 0–4 °C, 24 h (bake +1–2 min); −18 °C, 1 month (bake from frozen +4 min). Baked: serve at once.
1b695f7f.al: 1 Gluten (wheat) · 3 Eggs · 6 Soybeans (lecithin) · 7 Milk · check label (chocolate)

e0f5b9fa.yl: Yield: 10 ramekins (Ø 8 cm, 180 ml) · Portion: ≈ 90 g
c: Brush ramekins with soft butter in upward strokes; chill 10 min; brush again.
Coat with sugar; tip out the excess.
Make a pastry cream with milk, yolks, 30 g sugar and starch; boil 1 min.
Off the heat whisk in chocolate and cocoa; keep at 40 °C (or chill and warm to 40 °C for service).
Whip the whites, adding 90 g sugar gradually, to soft, glossy peaks.
Whisk ⅓ of the meringue into the base, fold in the rest.
Fill the ramekins to the rim; level; run a thumb around the edge.
Bake 190 °C convection 11–12 min (risen 3 cm, centre slightly soft); dust with icing sugar; serve at once with crème anglaise or vanilla ice cream.
e0f5b9fa.st: Base: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Baked soufflé: serve immediately.
e0f5b9fa.al: 3 Eggs (egg yolks, egg whites) · 6 Soybeans (dark chocolate 54%) · 7 Milk (butter, milk 3%, dark chocolate 54%)

ba9f05f8.yl: Yield: 20 pcs Ø 8 cm · Portion: 1 pc ≈ 65 g
c: Beat butter and sugar until light; add eggs gradually; fold in almond flour and flour; add rum and vanilla.
Pipe 30 g domes on paper; freeze 30 min (easier to wrap).
40 discs: 20 × Ø 7 cm base, 20 × Ø 9 cm lid
Roll puff 2.5 mm; cut 20 bases Ø 7 cm and 20 lids Ø 9 cm; chill.
Place a frozen frangipane dome on each base; brush the edge with water; cover with a lid; press out air; seal; trim with a Ø 8 cm cutter.
Brush with yolk-milk; chill 15 min; brush again; score curved lines from the centre; pierce a steam hole.
Bake 200 °C convection 18–20 min; dust with icing sugar; flash under the salamander to glaze.
Serve warm; under the heat lamp max 45 min.
ba9f05f8.st: Raw, assembled: −18 °C, 1 month (bake from frozen +5 min). Baked: same day.
ba9f05f8.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, puff pastry) · 3 Eggs (eggs, egg yolks) · 7 Milk (butter, puff pastry, milk 3%) · 8 Nuts (almond flour)

c: Core the apples with a corer (leave 1 cm at the base); score the skin around the middle.
Brush the cavity with lemon juice; stand in a GN 1/1.
Mix walnuts, raisins, 80 g honey, butter, sugar, cinnamon and zest; fill the apples, mounding the top.
Pour apple juice into the GN; drizzle the rest of the honey over the apples.
Bake 180 °C convection 25–30 min, basting twice (tender, not collapsed).
Hot-hold ≥ 63 °C with the juices; spoon liquor over at service.
d3b9fa00.al: 7 Milk (butter) · 8 Nuts (walnuts). Raisins may contain sulphites (check label).

c: Butter the GN and coat with sugar.
Core the pears; cut in eighths; lay in the GN.
Whisk eggs and sugar; add almond flour, flour and salt; whisk in milk, cream and vanilla until smooth; rest 20 min.
Pour over the pears; scatter flaked almonds.
Bake 170 °C convection 35–40 min (puffed, just set, golden).
Dust with icing sugar; serve warm; hot-hold ≥ 63 °C, max 1.5 h (sinks slightly, normal).
81b7f5bf.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (butter, milk 3%, cream 33%) · 8 Nuts (almond flour, almonds)

c: Peel pears leaving the stalk; core from the base with a melon baller.
Bring water, sugar, lemon, vanilla and cinnamon to the boil; add the pears.
Poach at 85–90 °C 10–15 min (knife-tender); cool in the syrup.
Drain and dry well on paper (wet pears make soggy pastry).
Almond cream ≈ 170 g · puff 50 g per pear
Beat butter and sugar; add egg, then almond flour; pipe 14 g into each pear cavity.
Cut puff pastry into 1.5 cm strips; wrap each pear spirally from the base up, overlapping slightly; chill 20 min.
Bake 200 °C convection 20–25 min (pastry deep golden, base crisp).
Serve warm; under the heat lamp max 40 min.
6cc3b3e9.st: Poached pears: 0–4 °C in syrup, 4 days. Wrapped raw: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Baked: same day.
6cc3b3e9.al: 1 Gluten (puff pastry) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (butter, puff pastry) · 8 Nuts (almond flour)

c: Pour the boiling water over the dates and soda; soak 10 min, blend to a purée.
Cream the butter and sugar until light; add the eggs one at a time.
Mix in the vanilla and date purée; fold in the sifted flour, baking powder and salt.
Pour into a buttered 30 × 20 cm tin; bake at 170 °C (160 °C convection) 30–35 min to a core of 94–96 °C.
Melt the butter; add the sugar and syrup; cook 2–3 min.
Whisk in the cream gradually; simmer 3–4 min until glossy.
Finish with the vanilla and salt.
Reheat a sponge portion to ≥75 °C core (oven 160 °C, 8 min, or microwave).
Spoon 45 g hot toffee sauce over; add a 60 g scoop of ice cream, 5 g pecans and a few flakes of salt.
c7cfdb79.st: Sponge: 0–4 °C, 5 days; −18 °C, 2 months. Toffee sauce: 0–4 °C, 7 days; hold hot at ≥63 °C max. 2 h.
c7cfdb79.al: 1 Gluten (wheat) · 3 Eggs · 7 Milk · 8 Nuts (pecan) · ice cream: check label

e84dfbb3.yl: Yield: ≈ 1600 g (1 tart Ø 26 cm, 10 portions) · Portion: 160 g
c: Cook a dry caramel in the tatin mould to 175–180 °C (amber); stir in the butter and vanilla.
Arrange halved apples upright, tightly packed.
Cook on the stove 10 min, then bake 170 °C convection 30 min.
Cover with a 3 mm puff pastry disc (see TTK Pâte Feuilletée); tuck in the edges; dock.
Bake 190 °C convection 25–30 min until the pastry is deep golden.
Rest 20 min; invert onto a plate while warm.
Serve warm with crème fraîche or vanilla ice cream.

6bade712.yl: Yield: 1 GN 1/2 · 12 portions · Portion: ≈ 175 g (135 g pudding + 40 g compote)
c: Sift flour, cocoa and baking powder; add sugar and salt.
Whisk milk, melted butter, eggs and vanilla; combine with the dry mix; fold in chopped chocolate.
Mix brown sugar and cocoa; sprinkle evenly over the batter.
Pour the boiling water gently over the back of a spoon; do not stir.
Bake 180 °C convection 30–35 min (top set and cracked, sauce bubbling underneath).
Rest 10 min; hot-hold ≥ 63 °C, max 2 h; serve sponge with sauce from the bottom.
Bring cherries and sugar to the boil; simmer 5 min.
Thicken with starch slaked in lemon juice; boil 1 min; serve warm.
6bade712.st: Pudding: 0–4 °C, 48 h; reheat covered 160 °C 20 min (core ≥ 75 °C). Compote: 0–4 °C, 5 days.
6bade712.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 6 Soybeans (dark chocolate 54%) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter, dark chocolate 54%)

9b78b728.yl: Yield: 1 tart Ø 26 cm · 12 portions · Portion: ≈ 100 g
c: Cream butter and icing sugar; add egg; add flour and salt; mix just to a dough; chill 1 h.
Roll 3 mm; line a buttered ring Ø 26 cm × 3 cm; chill 20 min.
Toast nuts 150 °C 8 min; arrange in the case.
Whisk eggs, sugar, maple, glucose, melted butter, vanilla and salt (do not aerate); pour over the nuts.
Bake 160 °C convection 35–40 min (set, slight wobble in the centre); cool 30 min before cutting.
Warm slices 160 °C 5 min; under the heat lamp max 45 min; brush with a little maple syrup for shine.
9b78b728.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (butter) · 8 Nuts (pecans, walnuts)

36a9455f.yl: Yield: Frame 40 × 30 cm · 48 pieces 5 × 5 cm · Portion: 70 g
c: Whisk eggs and sugar to ribbon stage, 8 min.
Fold in almonds, flour, baking powder and salt, then the melted butter.
Bake in the lined frame at 170 °C convection 18–20 min; cool in the frame.
Beat butter and sugar until pale; add eggs gradually; fold in almonds, flour, vanilla and salt.
Spread a thin layer of jam over the sponge in the frame; spread the frangipane on top; scatter flaked almonds.
Bake at 165 °C convection 35–40 min until golden and set in the centre (core ≥ 85 °C).
Cool; dust with icing sugar; cut 48 pieces.
36a9455f.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs · 7 Milk (butter) · 8 Nuts (almonds) · Apricot jam – check label

b1fce142.yl: Yield: 35 portions (3 pcs each) · 4095 g · Portion: 117 g
c: Batch · 30 × 20 cm frame · Yield ≈ 945 g baked (35 × 27 g)
Whisk eggs, sugar and salt to ribbon stage; combine with the chocolate, fold in flour and chopped walnuts.
Bake in a lined 30 × 20 cm frame at 170 °C convection, 18–20 min (moist centre, core ≥ 85 °C).
Bloom gelatine in cold water 10 min.
Heat cream, milk, sugar and split vanilla to 80 °C; dissolve squeezed gelatine, strain.
Cool over ice to 25 °C, stirring so the seeds stay suspended.
Pour 50 g into glasses; set ≥ 4 h at 0–4 °C.
Simmer berries, sugar and lemon juice 5 min; blend, pass through a fine sieve, chill to 4 °C.
Spoon 10 g onto each set panna cotta.
Rub butter into flour, icing sugar and salt; add egg, bring together; chill 1 h.
Roll 2.5 mm, line 5 cm moulds, blind-bake at 170 °C 12–14 min; cool.
Whisk juice, zest, sugar and eggs over a bain-marie to 82 °C until thick.
Off the heat blend in cold butter; pass.
Fill shells (≈ 14 g each); set 2 h at 0–4 °C.
Per guest: 1 brownie 27 g, 1 panna cotta with coulis 60 g, 1 lemon tartlet 30 g = 117 g.
Display on chilled trays; serve cold, ≤ 5 °C; replenish from the chiller in small batches.
Buffet labels per item: brownie 1, 3, 7, 8 · panna cotta 7 · tartlet 1, 3, 7.
b1fce142.st: Brownie: covered, 0–4 °C, 72 h; −18 °C, 1 month. Panna cotta: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Filled tartlets: 0–4 °C, 24 h; unfilled shells airtight, 5 days.
b1fce142.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs · 7 Milk (butter, cream, milk) · 8 Nuts (walnuts) · Chocolate: use soy-free couverture, otherwise add 6 Soybeans (lecithin) – check label

c: Cook the sugar, glucose and water to 170–175 °C (dark golden caramel).
Off the heat stir in the butter until melted.
Add the melted chocolate, cocoa and salt; stir smooth.
Spread 1–2 mm thick between two silicone mats; cool completely.
Break into irregular shards or cut to shape (≈12 g each).
Use as a crisp garnish for desserts, ice cream and mousses.
21329776.st: Airtight with silica gel at 18–20 °C, 14 days. Do not refrigerate or freeze (absorbs moisture, turns sticky).

d75d3034.yl: Yield: 32 cookies · Portion: 1 pc ≈ 37 g baked (40 g dough)
c: Cream butter and both sugars 2 min (do not over-aerate).
Add eggs and vanilla; mix in flour, soda and salt on low speed; fold in the chocolate.
Scoop 40 g balls; chill on trays min 12 h (24 h best).
Bake 175 °C convection 11–12 min: edges set, centre soft.
Cool 10 min on the tray before moving.
d75d3034.st: Dough: 0–4 °C, 3 days; −18 °C, 1 month (bake from frozen +2 min). Baked: airtight, 3 days.
d75d3034.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 6 Soybeans (dark chocolate 54%) · 7 Milk (butter, dark chocolate 54%)

c: Melt the chocolate, butter and cream over a bain-marie (max. 50 °C) until smooth.
Mix in the icing sugar, cocoa, vanilla and salt; add the zest and rum.
Fold in the roughly broken biscuits and chopped hazelnuts.
Divide in two; roll into tight cylinders in cling film.
Unwrap, roll in icing sugar, slice into 50 g portions.
5d4a0476.al: 1 Gluten (wheat) · 7 Milk · 8 Nuts (hazelnut) · 6 Soybeans (chocolate – check label) · biscuits: check label

c: Bring cream and glucose to the boil; pour over the chocolate in 3 additions, emulsifying with a spatula; blend.
At 35 °C blend in the butter; contact film; crystallise at 16–18 °C for 12 h.
Pipe or scoop 12 g pieces; roll by hand (gloves) into balls.
Roll in sifted cocoa (alternatives: chopped pistachio, coconut, tempered chocolate – see TTK Chocolate Tempering).
5d0ef5d2.st: Airtight, 12–16 °C, 2 weeks; 0–4 °C, 3 weeks (bring to room temperature before service).
5d0ef5d2.al: 6 Soybeans (dark chocolate 54%) · 7 Milk (cream 33%, dark chocolate 54%, butter)

c: Cook the butter to beurre noisette; strain; cool to 40–45 °C.
Mix the almond flour, icing sugar, plain flour and salt.
Stir in the egg whites until smooth – do not whisk.
Fold in the warm brown butter and vanilla.
Rest the batter at 0–4 °C at least 1 h (up to 24 h for more flavour).
Butter the financier moulds; fill ¾ full (≈33 g batter).
Bake at 180 °C (170 °C convection) 12–15 min until golden.
Cool 5 min, unmould onto a rack.
Serve 1 piece (≈30 g) at room temperature.
6d7a9110.st: Batter: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Baked: airtight at ≤20 °C, 2 days; −18 °C, 1 month.

326f87c5.yl: Yield: 40 sandwich cookies · Portion: 1 pc ≈ 23 g
c: Cream butter and icing sugar 2 min; add yolks and vanilla.
Dissolve the soda in the yoghurt; add; mix in the flour just until smooth.
Rest at 0–4 °C 1 h; roll 4 mm; cut Ø 5 cm discs (half of them with a small centre hole).
Dust the tops (holed discs) with icing sugar.
Spread ≈ 4 g jam on the bases; sandwich with the tops.
326f87c5.st: Airtight, room temperature, 1 week (softens after 24 h).
326f87c5.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (egg yolks) · 7 Milk (butter, yoghurt 3.6%)

bf824b89.yl: Yield: 40 madeleines · Portion: 1 pc ≈ 18 g baked
c: Whisk eggs, sugar, honey and zest until pale (2 min); add milk.
Fold in the sifted flour and baking powder, then the butter at 45 °C.
Cover; rest at 0–4 °C min 12 h (for the hump).
Pipe 20 g into buttered, floured moulds.
Bake 210 °C convection 4 min, then 180 °C 5–6 min until the hump rises and edges are golden.
Unmould at once; serve warm the same day.
bf824b89.st: Batter: 0–4 °C, 3 days. Baked: airtight, 24 h; −18 °C, 1 month.

2909e8db.yl: Yield: 48 pieces (3 × 3 cm) · Portion: 1 pc ≈ 25 g
c: Soften the marzipan; beat in the eggs gradually to a smooth, light batter (8 min).
Fold in sifted flour and baking powder, then the butter.
Bake in a lined frame 170 °C convection 20–22 min; cool; cut in 2 layers.
Sandwich the layers with boiled, strained jam; spread a thin jam layer on top.
Roll marzipan 2 mm; lay on top; press; chill 1 h; cut 48 squares 3 × 3 cm with a hot knife.
Warm fondant with water to 37 °C (never above 40 °C); tint.
Pour over the squares on a rack; set 15 min; decorate (piped chocolate, crystallised petals); place in paper cases.

7f44839f.yl: Yield: 70 pcs · 35 portions of 2 pcs · Portion: 46 g
c: Batch · Batter ≈ 1850 g · 70 × 26 g · Yield ≈ 1610 g baked
Brown the butter to hazelnut colour, cool to 40 °C.
Whisk eggs, sugar, honey and zest 3 min; fold in flour, pistachios, baking powder and salt, then the butter.
Cover and rest the batter ≥ 4 h (best overnight) at 0–4 °C.
Pipe 26 g into buttered, floured madeleine moulds.
Bake at 190 °C convection 4 min, then 170 °C 5–6 min until the humps rise and edges are golden. Unmould at once.
Dip the tips in chopped pistachio while warm (optional glaze of icing sugar and lemon not included).
Display 2 pcs per guest; best within 6 h of baking.
7f44839f.st: Batter: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Baked: airtight, room temperature, 24 h; −18 °C, 1 month.

ab46aa14.yl: Yield: 64 pieces (2.5 × 2.5 cm) · Portion: 1 pc ≈ 15 g
c: Frame 20 × 20 cm × 1.5 cm · ≈ 950 g after cooking
Mix the pectin with 50 g sugar; whisk into the purée at 40 °C; boil.
Add the remaining sugar in 3 additions and the glucose, keeping the boil.
Off the heat stir in the citric acid; pour at once into the frame on a silicone mat.
Cut 2.5 × 2.5 cm with an oiled knife or guitar.
Roll in sugar just before service.
ab46aa14.st: Airtight, dry, room temperature, 3 weeks (layers separated with paper).
ab46aa14.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Fat-free, dairy-free, egg-free, gelatine-free.

aa77f0db.yl: Yield: 60 pieces (3 × 3 cm) · Portion: 1 pc ≈ 15 g
c: Soak gelatine in ice water 10 min; squeeze.
Cook sugar, glucose and water to 116 °C.
Pour onto the invert sugar and gelatine in the mixer bowl; whip on high 8–10 min to 40 °C, thick and white; add vanilla.
Spread at once into the dusted frame; level; set at room temperature 12 h.
Dust the top; cut 3 × 3 cm with an oiled knife.
Toss each piece in the dusting mix; shake off the excess.
aa77f0db.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Gelatine: state the source (pork/beef) for guests with dietary needs. Fat-free.

c: Sift flour, baking powder, sugar and salt.
Whisk milk, egg yolks, melted butter and vanilla; mix into the dry ingredients.
Whip the whites to soft peaks; fold in.
Bake in a waffle iron at 190–200 °C, lightly oiled, 110 g batter, 3–4 min until golden and crisp.
Hold on a rack, uncovered, max 30 min.
Mix all except butter 5 min slow; add the butter; knead 8 min medium to a smooth, elastic dough (26 °C).
Bulk 1 h at 26 °C; divide 20 × 50 g; round tightly.
Proof on floured cloths at 30 °C, 70 % humidity, 45–60 min (×2); dry the surface 10 min uncovered.
Fry at 170 °C, top side down first, 2–3 min per side (cover the first minute) until golden with a pale ring.
Pipe 20 g jam through the side with a filling nozzle.
Dust with icing sugar just before service.
9e5df77c.st: Room temperature, same day. Fryer oil: discard at TPM ≥ 24 %.
9e5df77c.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (egg yolks, eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter)

c: Mix oats, milk, yoghurt and raisins; cover; soak at 0–4 °C overnight.
In the morning grate the apples, toss with lemon juice; fold in with the honey.
Adjust with a little milk if too thick.
Serve in bowls or glasses; top with toasted hazelnuts and fresh fruit.
f55616da.al: 1 Gluten (rolled oats) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, yoghurt 3.6%) · 8 Nuts (hazelnuts). Oats: check label for gluten. Raisins: check label for sulphites.

f6288b94.yl: Yield: ≈ 1130 g (28 pancakes) · Portion: 40 g (1 pancake)
c: Sift flour, baking powder, sugar and salt.
Whisk milk, eggs, melted butter and vanilla; add to the dry mix and stir briefly (small lumps are fine).
Griddle at 170–180 °C, lightly oiled; 45 g batter per pancake.
Flip when bubbles burst on the surface (1.5–2 min); cook 1 min more.
f6288b94.st: Batter: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Cooked: hot-hold ≥ 63 °C, max 1 h.

ceb0013e.yl: Yield: 18 pieces (12 croissants + 6 pain au chocolat) · Portion: 1 pc ≈ 55 g baked
c: Roll the laminated dough (see TTK Croissant/Danish Dough) to 4 mm at 4–6 °C.
Croissants: cut triangles 9 × 25 cm (≈ 60 g); notch the base; roll up without pressing; tips underneath.
Pain au chocolat: cut rectangles 8 × 15 cm; roll around 2 batons (5 g each).
Proof at 26–27 °C, 75 % humidity, 2–2.5 h until ×2.5 and wobbly (butter must not melt).
Egg wash twice (thin, avoid the cut layers).
Bake 175 °C convection 16–18 min until deep golden; cool on racks.
ceb0013e.st: Baked: room temperature, same day. Shaped raw: −18 °C, 1 month (thaw and proof overnight at 0–4 °C, then 1.5 h at 26 °C).
ceb0013e.al: 1 Gluten (croissant/danish dough) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 6 Soybeans (dark chocolate batons 44%) · 7 Milk (croissant/danish dough, dark chocolate batons 44%). Dough allergens as per TTK Croissant/Danish Dough.

d8f85537.yl: Yield: ≈ 1000 g (25 crêpes Ø 24 cm) · Portion: 40 g (1 crêpe)
c: Whisk flour, sugar and salt; whisk in eggs, then milk gradually, then melted butter and vanilla.
Cook on a lightly oiled crêpe griddle at 200–210 °C, 45 g batter each, 40–60 s per side.
Stack with baking paper; keep covered.
d8f85537.st: Batter: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Cooked: 0–4 °C, 48 h, wrapped; −18 °C, 1 month.

3b5c8248.yl: Yield: 18 muffins · Portion: 1 pc ≈ 65 g baked
c: Sift flour, cocoa, baking powder, soda and salt; add the sugar.
Whisk eggs, yoghurt, oil, milk and vanilla.
Fold wet into dry with a spatula until just combined (lumps are fine); fold in ⅔ of the chocolate.
Scoop 72 g into lined muffin cups; top with the rest of the chocolate.
Bake 190 °C convection 5 min, then 170 °C 15–17 min (skewer with moist crumbs).
3b5c8248.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 6 Soybeans (dark chocolate 54%) · 7 Milk (yoghurt 3.6%, milk 3%, dark chocolate 54%)

c: Rub the cold butter into flour, baking powder, sugar and salt to fine crumbs.
Add milk and egg; bring together lightly, do not knead.
Pat 3 cm thick; cut Ø 6 cm straight down (no twisting).
Egg wash the tops; rest 15 min; bake 200 °C convection 12–14 min until risen and golden.
Serve with clotted cream and jam. Variant: + 100 g raisins.
Cut bread 2 cm thick (30 slices × 20 g).
Whisk eggs, milk, cream, sugar, cinnamon and vanilla; strain.
Dip each slice 10–15 s per side; do not soak through.
Fry in butter on a griddle at 160–170 °C, 2 min per side, golden; or bake 180 °C convection 8–10 min.
71ca34b1.st: Egg mix: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Cooked: hot-hold ≥ 63 °C, max 1 h.
71ca34b1.al: 1 Gluten (toast bread) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, cream 33%, butter). Bread: check label (milk, soy, sesame).

c: Warm honey, oil, sugar, cinnamon, salt and vanilla to 50 °C.
Toss with oats, almonds and seeds until evenly coated.
Spread 1.5 cm thick on lined trays; bake 150 °C convection 25–30 min, turning every 10 min (press flat and leave the last 10 min for clusters).
Cool on the tray; break up and mix in the raisins.
1c50e3a7.al: 1 Gluten (rolled oats) · 8 Nuts (almonds). Raisins: check label for sulphites. Oats: gluten-free only if certified.

c: Stir the soda into the yoghurt (it foams); add egg, oil, salt and water.
Mix in the flour to a soft, sticky dough; do not knead long.
Cover; rest 30 min at room temperature.
With oiled hands pull pieces of 62 g into flat irregular discs 5 mm thick.
Deep-fry at 175 °C 1–1.5 min per side until golden and puffed.
Drain on paper; dust with icing sugar.
Serve warm with jam, honey or white brine cheese on the side.
c03b816d.st: Serve within 1 h; hot-hold max 30 min. Fryer oil: discard at TPM ≥ 24 %.

c: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm milk (35 °C); mix with flour, sugar, egg, cardamom and salt 4 min slow.
Add butter; knead 6–8 min medium to a smooth, elastic dough (24–26 °C).
Roll the dough 40 × 60 cm; spread butter mixed with sugar, cinnamon and cardamom.
Roll up tightly from the long side; cut into 30 pieces × 2 cm; place in paper cases or on a lined tray.
Glaze warm with icing sugar mixed with water; under the heat lamp max 45 min.
77682a34.st: Baked: room temp. 24 h airtight; −18 °C, 1 month; re-warm 160 °C 4 min.

bed1af5e.yl: Yield: 120 pcs (60 apricot + 60 sirene) for 77 guests, 15:00 coffee break · Portion: 1 pc, ≈ 35 g
c: Thaw dough at 0–4 °C overnight; cut 120 small triangles of 25 g.
Pipe 6 g thick apricot jam at the base, roll tightly; mark with a curved shape.
Mash sirene with egg; 6 g at the base, roll straight (no curve) to tell them apart.
Cool; dust sweet ones with icing sugar; serve on separate labelled platters (sweet / savoury).
bed1af5e.st: Baked: room temperature, max 6 h. Raw shaped: −18 °C, 2 weeks.
bed1af5e.al: 1 Gluten (croissant dough) · 3 Eggs (croissant dough, eggs) · 7 Milk (croissant dough, sirene)

56909534.yl: Yield: 40 croissants (side table 13:00–19:00) · Portion: 1 pc, ≈ 85 g
c: Thaw dough sheets at 0–4 °C overnight; keep cold while working.
Cut 40 triangles of 60 g; place 15 g ham and 15 g grated kashkaval at the base, roll tightly, tip underneath.
Prove at 26–28 °C, 75 % humidity, 60–90 min until doubled and wobbly.
Egg wash; bake 175 °C convection, 16–18 min until deep golden (core ≥ 75 °C).
Cool on racks; serve within 4 h at room temperature on platters.
56909534.st: Raw shaped croissants: −18 °C, 2 weeks (prove from frozen). Baked: room temperature, max 6 h; 0–4 °C, 24 h (refresh 160 °C, 4 min).
56909534.al: 1 Gluten (croissant dough) · 3 Eggs (croissant dough, eggs) · 7 Milk (croissant dough, kashkaval)

d2eec8ca.yl: Yield: ≈ 50 pieces · 10 portions × 5 pcs · Portion: ≈ 100 g
c: Boil sugar and water 5 min; add lemon; cool completely (syrup must be cold).
Boil water, butter and salt; add the flour; dry the panade 1–2 min.
Cool to 60 °C; beat in the eggs gradually to a smooth, firm paste.
Pipe 6 cm lengths with a star nozzle (12 mm) into oil at 160–165 °C; fry 5–6 min, turning, until golden and dry.
Drop hot into the cold syrup; soak 5 min; drain on a rack.

13d7e08c.yl: Yield: ≈ 1100 g (1 log 30 cm, 12 portions) · Portion: 90 g
c: Whisk eggs and sugar (warmed to 40 °C) to the ribbon stage; fold in sifted flour and cocoa.
Spread on a lined 40 × 30 cm tray; bake 200 °C convection 7–8 min.
Roll up warm in baking paper; cool.
Boil water and sugar for the syrup; cool.
Heat cream to 85 °C, pour over the chocolate, emulsify; add butter at 35–40 °C; set at room temperature 2–3 h to spreading texture.
Unroll the sponge, brush with syrup, spread ⅓ of the ganache; roll tight; chill 1 h.
Cut one end diagonally and attach as a stump; cover with the rest of the ganache; draw bark with a fork.
Chill min 2 h; dust with icing sugar, decorate (meringue mushrooms, berries).
13d7e08c.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 6 Soybeans (dark chocolate 54%) · 7 Milk (dark chocolate 54%, cream 33%, butter). Chocolate: check label (soy lecithin, milk, nut traces).

44d2c8ef.yl: Yield: 2 basins × 1 L · 16 portions · Portion: ≈ 100 g
c: Soak raisins and peel in the brandy overnight.
Grate the cold butter; mix with sugar, breadcrumbs, flour, almond flour and spice.
Add eggs, apple, treacle and zests; stir in the soaked fruit.
Fill 2 buttered 1 L basins; cover with pleated paper and foil; tie.
Steam 6 h (topping up water); cool; re-wrap; mature in a cool, dry place 4 weeks.
To serve: steam 2 h; turn out; serve with brandy butter or crème anglaise.
44d2c8ef.st: Cool, dry, dark place, 3 months, wrapped. After reheating: 0–4 °C, 5 days.
44d2c8ef.al: 1 Gluten (breadcrumbs, wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (butter) · 8 Nuts (almond flour) · 14 Sulphites (candied orange peel). Contains alcohol (brandy). Raisins: check label for sulphites.

e10495f3.yl: Yield: ≈ 1650 g baked (2 stollen, 33 slices) · Portion: 50 g
c: Sponge: milk (30 °C), yeast and 100 g flour, 30 min.
Add rest of flour, sugar, salt, yolks, zest, spice and butter; knead on medium to a smooth dough (26 °C).
Mix in raisins, candied fruit and almonds on slow speed only; bulk 45–60 min.
Batch · Yield ≈ 1650 g baked and finished
Divide in 2; roll each out, place a 100 g marzipan log in the middle and fold into the stollen shape.
Brush hot with melted butter twice; dust heavily with icing sugar; cool and wrap.
e10495f3.st: Wrapped airtight, room temperature: 3–4 weeks (best after 1 week).
e10495f3.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (egg yolks) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter) · 8 Nuts (almonds, marzipan) · 14 Sulphites (candied fruit mix). Raisins: check label for sulphites.

a3d2846e.yl: Yield: 90 slices per coffee break (6 loaves 26 × 10 cm, 15 slices each) · Portion: 50 g
c: Mix raisins, candied fruit and rum; cover and soak min 2 h or overnight at 0–4 °C.
Batch · Batter ≈ 5270 g (≈ 875 g per tin) · Yield ≈ 4500 g baked
Cream soft butter (18–20 °C), sugar, zest and vanilla 5 min until pale and light.
Add room-temperature eggs one by one, beating well after each; add 2 tbsp flour if it starts to split.
Toss fruit in 100 g of the flour; fold the rest of the flour, baking powder and salt in, then the fruit.
6 lined loaf tins 26 × 10 cm, ≈ 875 g each; bake at 160 °C convection, 55–60 min, skewer clean (core ≥ 96 °C).
Cool in tins 10 min, then on a rack; slice cold, 15 slices × 50 g per loaf.
a3d2846e.st: Soaked fruit: 0–4 °C, 7 days. Baked cake: room temperature, wrapped, 4 days; −18 °C, 2 months. Slice on the day.
a3d2846e.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (butter). 14 Sulphites if raisins or candied fruit are sulphited: check label.

7dcab937.yl: Yield: ≈ 860 g baked (43 cookies) · Portion: 20 g (1 cookie)
c: Melt honey, sugar and butter to 50 °C; cool to 35 °C; mix in the egg.
Add sifted flour, spices, soda and salt; mix to a smooth dough.
Roll 4–5 mm; cut shapes; rest 15 min chilled.
Bake 170 °C convection 8–10 min; cool on racks; decorate with royal icing.
7dcab937.st: Airtight, room temperature: 3 weeks. Dough: −18 °C, 2 months.

d8dd68d2.yl: Yield: ≈ 1250 g (2 braided loaves, 21 slices) · Portion: 60 g
c: Sponge: warm milk (30 °C), yeast, 1 tbsp sugar, 100 g flour; 30 min.
Add rest of flour, sugar, eggs, yolks, zest, vanilla, rum and salt; knead 10 min medium until stringy.
Add butter and oil gradually; knead until smooth and elastic; fold in the raisins.
Divide in 2; braid each from 3 strands; place in lined tins.
Proof at 28 °C 1–1.5 h (×2); egg wash; sprinkle almonds and sugar.
Bake 170 °C convection 30–35 min (core 92 °C); cover with foil if browning fast.
d8dd68d2.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs, egg yolks) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter) · 8 Nuts (almonds). Raisins: check label for sulphites.

9c17212d.yl: Yield: 24 mini pies (Ø 6 cm) · Portion: 1 pc ≈ 50 g
c: Batch · ≈ 790 g (600 g used) · make 3 days ahead
Dice the apples 5 mm; mix all ingredients.
Cover; mature at 0–4 °C min 3 days, stirring daily.
Rub butter into flour, icing sugar and salt; add egg and water; rest 1 h at 0–4 °C.
Roll 3 mm; line 24 mini tart moulds (Ø 7 cm cutter); fill 25 g mincemeat.
Top with star-cut lids; egg wash.
Bake 180 °C convection 18–20 min; cool 10 min in the moulds; dust with icing sugar.
9c17212d.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (butter) · 14 Sulphites (candied orange peel). Contains alcohol (brandy). Raisins: check label for sulphites.

c: Rub cold butter into flour, almond flour, icing sugar and salt; add yolks and vanilla; bring together quickly.
Roll 10 g pieces into 6 cm logs with tapered ends; bend into crescents on lined trays.
Bake 165 °C convection 12–14 min, just coloured at the tips.
Mix icing sugar with vanilla seeds or vanilla sugar.
Roll the crescents while still warm (they are fragile); cool completely.
28b00b10.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (egg yolks) · 7 Milk (butter) · 8 Nuts (almond flour)

c4915619.yl: Yield: 10 glasses · Portion: ≈ 127 g (95 g pudding + 32 g topping)
c: Whisk milk, yoghurt, honey and vanilla; whisk in the chia.
Cover; set at 0–4 °C min 6 h (overnight best).
Top with 30 g berries and a drizzle of honey.
c4915619.al: 7 Milk (milk 3%, greek yoghurt 10%). Vegan option: plant drink + coconut yoghurt + agave.

c: Boil water and sugar 1 min; add lemon juice and mint off the heat; infuse 20 min, strain, chill to 4 °C.
Batch · Yield ≈ 4720 g · seasonal fruit may be swapped like for like
Wash all fruit in cold running water; work on a clean fruit board.
Peel and cut pineapple, melon and kiwi into 1.5 cm dice; segment oranges; halve grapes; quarter strawberries; dice apples last and toss in a little syrup to prevent browning.
Combine fruit with 525 g syrup; chill to ≤ 5 °C.
Buffet: in a chilled glass bowl on ice. Set menu: 150 g in a bowl, 1 mint tip on top; with sorbet, add 1 scoop (50 g) bought sorbet – check label (not in nutrition).
Serve ≤ 5 °C; discard after 2 h on display.
ebf7b7f5.st: Cut fruit salad: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Syrup: 0–4 °C, 7 days.
ebf7b7f5.al: None of the 14 allergens · Sorbet (if served) – check label

542255ca.yl: Yield: ≈ 1000 g (1 cake Ø 24 cm, 12 portions) · Portion: 80 g
c: Whisk eggs, sugar and vanilla 5 min until pale; fold in the chocolate.
Sift cocoa and salt over; fold in.
Pour into a lined ring Ø 24 cm; bake 160 °C convection 30–35 min until set at the edge with a slight wobble in the centre.
Cool; chill min 4 h before cutting with a hot knife.
542255ca.al: 3 Eggs (eggs) · 6 Soybeans (dark chocolate 54%) · 7 Milk (dark chocolate 54%, butter). Cocoa and chocolate: check label for gluten. Prepare with cleaned equipment, away from flour.

799ef8db.yl: Yield: 1 cake Ø 20 cm · 10 portions · Portion: 140 g
c: Crush the biscuits to fine crumbs; mix with the melted butter.
Press firmly into a 20 cm ring lined with parchment; wrap the outside of the ring in foil.
Bake in a convection oven at 150 °C for 10 min. Cool completely.
Beat the cream cheese with the sugar on low speed until smooth; do not aerate.
Add the honey, sour cream, vanilla, zests, salt and corn starch; mix until smooth.
Add the eggs one at a time on low speed, then the citrus juices.
Bake in a water bath in a convection oven at 150 °C (fan low) for 60–70 min, to a core temperature of 70 °C: edges set, centre with a slight wobble.
Switch off the oven and leave the cake inside, door ajar, for 1 h.
Chill uncovered to below 5 °C, then cover and chill a minimum of 8 h (ideally overnight).
Brush a thin layer over the chilled cheesecake just before cutting.
Cut into 10 portions with a hot, wiped knife (≈140 g each).
Garnish each with 15 g orange segments, a little lemon zest and a mint tip.
799ef8db.st: Cheesecake: 0–4 °C, 72 h. Unglazed whole cake: −18 °C, 1 month; thaw at 0–4 °C overnight.
799ef8db.al: 3 Eggs · 7 Milk · GF biscuits: check label (must be certified gluten-free)

c: Soak gelatine in ice water 10 min.
Warm ⅓ of the purée with erythritol to 50 °C; dissolve the squeezed gelatine; mix with the rest of the purée and lemon.
Whip the cream to soft peaks; fold in.
Pour into glasses; set at 0–4 °C min 4 h; top with fresh berries.
ec995192.al: 7 Milk (greek yoghurt 10%, cream 33%). Sweetened with erythritol; contains natural sugars from fruit and dairy.

c: Rinse the dried fruit; soak in the water 1 h.
Add sugar, cinnamon, cloves and zest; bring to the boil; simmer gently 10 min.
Off the heat stir in the honey; cool; remove the spices.
Chill overnight; serve cold in bowls with the liquid (traditional for Christmas Eve, Bădni Vecher).
a5a7b098.al: 14 Sulphites (dried apricots, dried apple rings). Vegan if honey is replaced with sugar. Dried fruit: check labels for sulphites.

9bd57002.yl: Yield: 10 pears + 400 g sauce · Portion: 1 pear (120 g) + 40 g sauce
c: Peel the pears, keep the stalk, core from the base; rub with lemon.
Bring wine, water, sugar and spices to the boil.
Add pears, cover with a paper lid; simmer at 85–90 °C 20–30 min until a knife goes in easily.
Cool the pears in the liquid overnight (colour).
Reduce 1 litre of the liquid to ≈ 400 g syrup; serve 1 pear with 40 g sauce.
9bd57002.al: 14 Sulphites (red wine). Alcohol largely evaporated in reduction.

c: Batch · Yield ≈ 900 g pears + 150 g glaze
Boil water, sugar, lemon, vanilla, saffron 2 min; add peeled, halved, cored pears; cartouche; poach 80–85 °C 15–20 min until tender.
Cool in the syrup overnight at 0–4 °C for colour; reduce 300 g syrup to 150 g glaze.
Cream soft butter with sugar; add yolks; fold in sifted flour, baking powder and salt.
Chill 1 h; roll 8 mm; cut 7 cm discs; bake in rings at 165 °C 14–16 min until golden.
Boil water, sugar and glucose 1 min; cool; mix with purée and lemon (28–30 °Brix); churn; freeze −18 °C; temper to −12 °C to shape.
Sablé disc off-centre, fanned pear half on top brushed with glaze; 60 g sorbet quenelle on crumbs beside it; raspberries, mint.
ba80bd48.st: Pears in syrup: 0–4 °C, 5 days. Sablé: airtight, 3 days. Sorbet: −18 °C, 2 weeks.

4adee705.yl: Yield: 125 portions per coffee break (7 platters) · Portion: 80 g
c: Wash all whole fruit under running water before peeling; work on the green board.
Pineapple peeled and cored, cut in 1 cm half-moons; melon peeled and deseeded, 1 cm slices.
Kiwi peeled, 7 mm slices; oranges peeled to the flesh, 7 mm rounds; grapes in small bunches.
Arrange by colour in rows on 7 platters, pomegranate seeds and mint tips on top; cling film, 0–4 °C.
Cut max 3 h before service; to the lobby 10 min before start, max 2 h at room temperature.
4adee705.st: Cut fruit: 0–4 °C, max 6 h, covered. Leftovers from the lobby: discard.

c: Dice the apples 1.5 cm; toss with sugar, lemon, cinnamon and starch.
Rub the cold solid coconut oil into flour, oats, sugar and salt to coarse crumbs; chill 20 min.
Bake 170 °C convection 35–40 min until golden and bubbling at the edges.
78492c15.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, rolled oats). Dairy-free, egg-free.

c: Chill the aquafaba (drained from canned chickpeas) to 4 °C.
Whip with lemon juice to soft peaks (5–6 min); add sugar gradually, whip to stiff, glossy peaks (≈ 10 min).
Melt the chocolate at 45 °C; cool to 35–38 °C; add vanilla and salt.
Fold ⅓ of the foam vigorously into the chocolate, then the rest gently.
Pipe into glasses at once; set at 0–4 °C min 4 h.
10eb5ab2.st: 0–4 °C, 48 h, covered. Use separate vegan-labelled equipment.
10eb5ab2.al: 6 Soybeans (dark chocolate 70%). Chocolate: check label (milk traces). Dairy-free, egg-free.

c: Dice the segments; heat with the water, zest and 75 g of the sugar.
Mix the pectin with the remaining 15 g sugar; whisk in; boil 1 min.
Whisk the juice, zest, sugar, eggs and yolks; cook to 82–84 °C, stirring constantly.
Off the heat blend in the butter; strain; cover with film on the surface.
Bloom the gelatine in cold water; melt at max. 60 °C.
Temper into a little yoghurt, then mix into the rest with the icing sugar and zest.
Fold in the softly whipped cream; set at 0–4 °C at least 3 h.
Temper the white chocolate (melt 45 °C, cool 26 °C, work at 28–29 °C).
Spread thinly on acetate strips; shape into waves when part-set; let set fully.
Per portion: 35 g compote, 20 g curd, 85 g mousse (quenelle or piped), 1 chocolate wave (≈6 g).
Garnish with lemon zest, edible flowers or micro herbs. Assemble at the moment of service.
e909e589.st: Mousse: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Curd: 0–4 °C, 5 days; −18 °C, 2 months. Compote: 0–4 °C, 7 days. Waves: airtight, 16–18 °C, 2 weeks.
e909e589.al: 3 Eggs · 7 Milk · 6 Soybeans (white chocolate – check label)

c: Boil butter, sugar, glucose, honey and cream to 115 °C.
Off the heat stir in almonds, chopped orange peel and flour.
Spread thin on silicone mats (or spoon small rounds).
Bake 170 °C convection 8–10 min until golden; cut while warm. Optional: coat the base with tempered chocolate.
9462d793.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 7 Milk (butter, cream 33%) · 8 Nuts (almonds) · 14 Sulphites (candied orange peel). Candied peel: check label for sulphites.

c: Rub or paddle the cold butter (4 °C) into the dry ingredients to pea-sized crumbs; do not form a dough.
Spread on a tray; chill or freeze 30 min.
Use raw on muffins, cakes and fruit tarts, or bake loose at 160 °C convection 15–18 min, stirring once.
Cool on the tray (crisps as it cools).
5e5bbf8d.st: Raw: 0–4 °C, 1 week; −18 °C, 2 months. Baked: airtight, 2 weeks.

c: Dice the apples 1 cm; toss with lemon juice.
Melt butter, add apples, sugar, cinnamon and vanilla.
Cook covered on medium heat 8–10 min until tender but holding shape (15 min for a smooth compote).

50aac783.yl: Yield: ≈ 860 g (2 sheets 60 × 40 cm) · Portion: 30 g
c: Whisk almond flour, icing sugar and eggs 8–10 min until pale and doubled; fold in the sifted flour.
Whip the whites with the sugar to firm, glossy peaks; fold in 2 additions.
Spread 485 g per 60 × 40 cm silicone mat (≈ 5 mm).
Bake 220 °C convection 6–8 min until light golden and springy.
Cool covered with paper to keep it flexible; roll while warm for Swiss rolls.
50aac783.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs, egg whites) · 7 Milk (butter) · 8 Nuts (almond flour)

c: Cut peel in 6 mm strips (with 2 mm pith).
Blanch 3 times from cold water, boiling 3 min each time; drain.
Bring water, sugar and glucose to the boil; add the peel; simmer very gently 30 min; leave in the syrup overnight.
Next day boil 15 min; leave overnight. Repeat until translucent (2–3 days).
Drain; dry on a rack at 50 °C 2–3 h, or leave in syrup.
Optional: roll in sugar or dip half in tempered dark chocolate.
2ce9fb8a.st: In syrup: 0–4 °C, 3 months. Dried: airtight, 1 month.
2ce9fb8a.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Made in-house: sulphite-free.

c: Roast the nuts 150 °C convection 12 min; keep warm.
Cook sugar and water to 118 °C; add the warm nuts; stir until the sugar crystallises (sandy).
Keep stirring on medium heat until the sugar melts again and coats the nuts in amber caramel.
Stir in butter and salt; tip onto a silicone mat; separate the nuts at once (gloves).
Cool; use whole, chopped, or blitzed into praline paste.
Bring cream, milk, glucose and sugar mixed with cocoa to the boil, whisking.
Pour over the chopped chocolate; rest 1 min; blend smooth without air.
Serve at 45–50 °C (profiteroles, ice cream, crêpes) or cold as a dip.
a9c172ce.st: 0–4 °C, 1 week. Reheat in a bain-marie to 50 °C.
a9c172ce.al: 6 Soybeans (dark chocolate 54%) · 7 Milk (cream 33%, milk 3%, dark chocolate 54%)

6be01a19.yl: Yield: 2 rings Ø 24 cm (≈ 750 g baked) · Portion: 40 g
c: Whisk eggs and sugar over a bain-marie to 45 °C; whip to ribbon stage (10–12 min).
Sift flour and cocoa twice; fold in gently in 3 additions.
Fold a little batter into the warm butter (45 °C), then fold it back in.
Bake in 2 lined rings 170 °C convection 25–30 min (or a 40 × 60 cm sheet 200 °C 8–9 min).
Cool upside down on a rack; level and cut into layers.

9dc6384b.yl: Yield: 1000 g tempered chocolate · Portion: 10 g
c: Add ⅓ (300 g) callets; stir to 31–32 °C (milk 29–30 °C, white 28–29 °C).
Test: a strip on paper sets glossy in 3–5 min at 20 °C with a clean snap.
Keep at working temperature; re-warm by 1 °C max if it thickens.
Set finished pieces at 15–18 °C; do not refrigerate.
9dc6384b.al: 6 Soybeans (dark couverture 56%) · 7 Milk (dark couverture 56%). Couverture: check label (milk, nut traces).

c: Soak gelatine in ice water 10 min.
Boil water, sugar and cream; whisk in the sifted cocoa.
Off the heat add the squeezed gelatine; blend without air; strain.
Melt to 35–40 °C; glaze frozen entremets (−18 °C) in one pour.

99362206.yl: Yield: 950 g dough (47 shells/biscuits) · Portion: 20 g
c: Paddle butter, icing sugar, almond flour and salt to a smooth paste.
Add eggs, then sifted flour and cocoa; mix just to combine.
Roll 2.5–3 mm; line or cut; bake 160 °C convection 12–15 min until firm (colour is hard to judge).
99362206.st: Dough: 0–4 °C, 5 days; −18 °C, 1 month. Baked: airtight, 5 days.
99362206.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (butter) · 8 Nuts (almond flour)

0b52bee1.yl: Yield: ≈ 840 g (168 discs) · Portion: 5 g (1 disc)
c: Paddle soft butter with the brown sugar; add flour, mix just to a paste.
Roll 1.5–2 mm between baking papers; freeze 30 min.
Cut discs the size of the piped choux (Ø 3–4 cm).
Place on raw choux; bake as Pâte à Choux (165 °C convection).
Beat soft butter and icing sugar 3 min until pale.
Add the cold cream cheese in 2 additions; beat on medium only until smooth (30–60 s); over-beating makes it runny.
Add vanilla; chill 30 min before piping.

37b102d5.yl: Yield: ≈ 1100 g dough (18 croissants × 60 g raw) · Portion: 60 g
c: Mix 4 min slow, 2 min medium to a smooth dough (24 °C).
Flatten to a rectangle, film; retard at 0–4 °C for 12 h.
Batch · Yield ≈ 1100 g dough after trimming
Lock in the butter plaque at 12–14 °C; give 1 double + 1 single turn, 30 min rest at 0–4 °C between turns.
Roll 4 mm; cut triangles 9 × 22 cm (60 g); roll up. For Danish: cut squares, fill with crème pâtissière/fruit.
Proof at 26–28 °C, 75–80 % RH, 2–2.5 h until wobbly (×2.5 volume).
Egg wash twice; bake 175 °C convection 16–18 min until deep golden.
37b102d5.st: Raw shaped: −18 °C, 1 month (thaw overnight at 0–4 °C, then proof). Baked: same day.
37b102d5.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter, butter 82%)

20469326.yl: Yield: ≈ 980 g raw (32 portions) · Portion: 30 g
c: Batch · Yield ≈ 980 g raw (≈ 930 g baked)
Mix flour, sugar, salt and cinnamon.
